about_the_game:
In the 500 years since the world experienced a catastrophic apocalypse, magic has begun to seep into the world. Although devastated by the event, humanity has begun to harness this power, and is currently experiencing a golden age of expansion and growth.

As a newly graduated United City States Militia Commander, you have been tasked with heading to the western frontier. A fast-spreading goblin infestation has taken over an old-world underground mega-facility, and you've been tasked to clear it out.

ARKCORP, working in conjunction with the UCS Militia, has provided the operation with a cutting edge M-TEK computer, capable of administering an entire base from one machine. With this tech, you can:

  • Read Emails

  • Construct Shops

  • Purchase and Sell Equipment

  • Hire and Assign Operators

  • Equip Operators and deploy them into the field

Once deployed into the field, take direct control of your operator and explore the underground depths of「NA-LRC/A-07」 an old world fortress constructed before the apocalypse. Fight hordes of creatures, dodge projectiles, and make your way towards the source of the goblin infestation in the depths below.

WARNING: Losing an operator in the field will result in them permanently dying along with total equipment loss. Careful preparation and tactical gameplay will ensure success in the field.

To combat this issue, a one-way teleportation system has been setup to allow instant extraction of operators. While this failsafe enables escape, operator safety remains dependent on proper resource management in the field.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features semi-realistic depictions of violence. The player can kill various enemies, with blood and gore present after doing so. The player can also choose to consume various drugs in game that provide benefits and drawbacks.

name: Creature Containment

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit versions only.
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, and DX12-capable GPUs
  • Additional Notes: Hardware vendor officially supported drivers.

short_description: Creature Containment is a hybrid Base Management/Top-Down shooter. As a newly graduated Militia Commander, you've been charged with wiping out a goblin infestation that's taken over an old-world underground facility. Manage your base, equip your operators, and fight hordes of creatures underground.
